report.source: GeckoTerminal index of Monad mainnet DEX trades
report.selection_rule: Lowest validation weighted cross-entropy; test is evaluated only after model selection
limitations: GeckoTerminal indexed USD candles, not raw self-verified swap logs
Historical replay, not real wallet trades
No fabricated candles; all feature/label windows require consecutive hours
No profitability guarantee; gas is excluded from backtests
Pool selection uses present liquidity and creates selection bias
Past pooled assets are correlated and the history is short

model.rounding: inputs/parameters: ties-to-even; dense: truncation toward zero; argmax: first tie
